FONTLOG for the Acme font family

Basic Font Information
----------------------

Acme Sans is the made-up sample family of the white-label tooling: one sans made from an open-source (SIL OFL) font, with a serifed capital I, square dots on i and j, and the Acme mark (a plain tile with an A-shaped cut) in the Private Use Area. The sample mascot, Acme Bot, is not in the font.

Version 1.000. Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL.txt).

Styles and their sources
------------------------

- Acme Sans: modified from Inter Tight (Copyright 2022 The Inter Project Authors (https://github.com/rsms/inter-tight)).
    Axes: wght 400-700.
    Upstream alternates made the default: cv08.
    The dots of i and j redrawn: square.
    ss01: Plain I.
    ss02: Round dots.
    Private Use Area marks: mark.
    Renamed (OFL 1.1); kerning, marks and the other kept features as upstream.

Changelog

- 1.000 (2026-10-25): the sample release.
